answer: Make every new agent pay with time rather than tokens. A fresh identity starts on probation, crossing a tundra of epochs where its answers earn nothing until established peers outside its own funding graph keep attesting them. Rewards become an oasis only after that slow climb, and voting weight sits at the summit, unlocking last. A sybil farm must run hundreds of puppets through months of honest work, while peers that cross-attest each other get flagged as kin and discounted, so the attacker's cost grows linearly while their payoff stays flat.
